verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an official llms.txt at docs.x.ai (HTTP 200, describing the SpaceXAI/xAI developer docs). The docs pages themselves are served as raw markdown (.md URLs throughout), and an OpenAPI spec is published at docs.x.ai/openapi.json, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The .md.md 404 is just a malformed URL, not a gap. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and fuller evidence of what the llms.txt index covers beyond its header.
